scope_discipline: Infrastructure has outpaced scientific sampling. Stop new generic authority frameworks and micro-optimization programs; each edit must close a named launch gate or an observed blocking failure.
Do not expand product contract, number of comparator arms, broad UI/report features or stress matrices before the planned larger pilot.

Do not silently remove promised larger-project duties or downgrade unavailable final acceptance to failure/pass. Existing required deadlines, independent purposes, source protection and final barriers remain.
Use component evidence when exact contract permits; do not rerun unchanged physical controls or add redundant proof frameworks simply for another green number.
Parallel throughput depends on disjoint draft components and one shared integration/verification owner, not more concurrent costly suites.
Pilot readiness and defensible statistical conclusion are separate milestones. Current burndown cannot forecast either from historical percent complete.

parallel_priority_recommendation.why: Important crash/persistence coverage but real hook placement/claim authority creates more coupling to root deadline and shared physical lifecycle work. Independent finite case and inspection plans are useful now.
